weapon.d: Effective against dragon foes. Grants Atk+3. At start of combat, if unit's Atk > foe's Atk, grants Atk/Res+6 during combat.

special.d: Boosts damage by 30% of unit's Atk.
Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Atk.

a.d: If unit initiates combat, grants Res+2 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk/Res+2 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk/Res+4 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk+6, Res+10 during combat and foe cannot make a follow-up attack.

b.d: Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-2 on foe, neutralizes foe's bonuses (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.), and disables foe's skills that "calculate damage using the lower of foe's Def or Res" during combat.

Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-5 on foe, neutralizes unit's penalties and foe's bonuses (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.), and disables foe's skills that "calculate damage using the lower of foe's Def or Res" during combat.

c.d: At start of turn, if unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Res+3 to unit for 1 turn.
At start of turn, if unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Res+4 to unit for 1 turn.
At start of turn, if unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Res+5 to unit for 1 turn.
At start of turn, inflicts Res-3 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
At start of turn, inflicts Atk/Res-3 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
At start of turn, inflicts Atk/Res-4 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
At start of turn, if unit is within 4 spaces of a foe, inflicts Atk/Res-6 on nearest foes through their next actions and grants Atk/Res+6 to unit for 1 turn.
